jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Velvet Box
jokes.joke: A client once tried to pay me for a custom necklace with a fat envelope of cash and said, ‘No receipt.’ I told him, ‘I’m a jewelry designer, not a money launderer.’ He said, ‘Can you at least make it look legitimate?’ So I put the cash in a tiny velvet box. Suddenly it was luxury.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Blood Diamond, But Make It Petty
jokes.joke: I'm a jewelry designer, so occasionally a sketchy guy offers me cash to make something ‘untraceable.’ I always say no. Not because I'm noble — because my real skill is engraving, and I know within four business days his girlfriend is getting a ring that says ‘Forever’ in a font clearly picked by someone who was very, very nervous.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: The Bribe
jokes.joke: A guy in a trench coat offered me twenty grand in dirty money to keep my mouth shut. Most people would be terrified of the mafia, or at least worried about going to federal prison. Not me. I'm way too childish. I just stared at the briefcase full of cash and immediately thought, ‘Oh man... I can finally afford the big Lego Death Star.’

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Clean Cash Only
jokes.joke: I'm a jewelry designer. Last week a client offered me a thick stack of dirty money for a custom necklace. I turned it down flat. Figured if I start taking dirty money, the only gems I'll be setting next are the ones they hand you in prison.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Shiny Loyalty
jokes.joke: I dated a jewelry designer who said she loved how loyal I was. Meanwhile I was basically a kid with a treasure box. Every time she showed me a new piece, I’d gasp and yell, ‘Mine!’ One night she tried to have a serious talk about our future, and I just held up a bracelet and said, ‘Can we discuss this after snack time?’
